summary: The upload-service showed rising memory usage, reaching 85% of its container limit, then critical memory pressure and OOM kill, with corresponding warnings and errors logged in quick succession.

evidence.excerpt: 2026-08-28T14:09:00Z WARN [upload-service] Memory usage at 85% of container limit (850MB / 1024MB)
evidence.interpretation: Indicates high memory consumption approaching container limit.

evidence.excerpt: 2026-08-28T14:11:00Z ERROR [upload-service] System memory pressure critical: 990MB resident
evidence.interpretation: Shows memory pressure became critical, near full usage.

evidence.excerpt: 2026-08-28T14:11:32Z FATAL [kernel] Out of memory: Kill process 1842 (python) score 982 or sacrifice child
evidence.interpretation: Kernel OOM event triggered, selecting a process to kill.

evidence.excerpt: 2026-08-28T14:11:33Z ERROR [docker] Container upload-service died with exit code 137 (OOMKilled)
evidence.interpretation: Container terminated due to OOM kill.

evidence.excerpt: 2026-08-28T14:05:40Z WARN [upload-service] [s3-client] AWS STS temporary credentials renewal check scheduled - distractor
evidence.interpretation: Unrelated warning, likely not linked to memory issue.
